notes.title: Happy Game wins an award!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/9163cb7abed9db2802cf7fe8a271b6ef7024ea53.jpg[/img]

The Czech Game of the Year 2021 show aired last night and we were honored with the award for Best Audiovisual Design! Please join us in feeling happy ːhgveryhappyː

If you're curious, you can rewatch the entire show on YouTube via this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=28MSrerXtxM]link[/url]. It's in Czech, so don't be surprised if you happen not to understand a single word :) Congratulations to our fellow nominees and winners!

notes.title: Happy Game got physical!
notes.content:
Have you ever wished to bring a little piece of Happy Game in your home...? Well, now is the time. ːhgveryhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/3e873699e6812c48fbd3c521b393fc51c6043815.jpg[/img]

The Xzone Edition, made in collaboration with Czech company Xzone is now for [url=https://merch.amanita-design.net/collections/frontpage/products/happy-game-xzone-edition]sale in our shop[/url], and since all of these include a screen-printed card signed by the game's creator Jaromír Plachý, there's only a few hundred of these available. Do not hesitate if you need this in your collection! Might as well be a nice gift for, uh... basically anyone, right?

Here's all that is included:
- Happy Game Steam key (Windows, Mac)
- 50-page mini artbook
- Screen-printed card signed by Jaromír Plachý
- Slip-cover packaging
- Exclusive sticker set
- Temporary tattoo set
- Downloadable original soundtrack by DVA

ːhgveryhappyː ːhgveryhappyː ːhgveryhappyː

notes.title: MUSIC VIDEO: 'Let's Play' from Happy Game Soundtrack
notes.content:
Music fans, hello! This one's for you - a brand new music video for the creepy track [i]Let's Play[/i] from [i]Happy Game Soundtrack[/i], performed and recorded by our beloved Czech duo [url=http://www.2dva.cz/]DVA[/url]. The video was put together from Jaromir Plachy's countless concept drawings and happy ideas, many of which didn't make it into the game but still deserved to be seen... Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=FR9c1mX0efY;full][/previewyoutube]

But that's not at all. If you prefer to listen to your music via streaming platforms, we've got you covered too - please find [i]Happy Game Soundtrack[/i] on all the major platforms via the link below. If you've already listened, which song makes you the happiest?

Stream [i]Happy Game Soundtrack[/i]: lnkfi.re/HappyGameOST

Thanks for the support, and cheers to a happier year! ːhgveryhappyː

notes.title: Make Your Steam Profile Happy!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/ce5a580e5053c2dcfc84e25b396811217a681b0e.jpg[/img]

And, well, that's just what we've added - 6 animated stickers you can use in your Steam chats, as well as 4 animated avatars to make you look truly happy here on Steam ːhgveryhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/f9785b2dbc59500379a9d745594c24ef22a0b0e8.jpg[/img]

The Steam Awards are back, and it's time to pick your nominees! notes.title: Happy Game adds Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/6dbc8027f792c4b1145ac38df9a73eb2fee9ca29.png[/img]

There are two kinds of people in this world: those who have played Happy Game, and those who haven't.

If you have played Happy Game, you should keep an eye on your Steam Inventory, because we've just released a set of Steam Trading Cards featuring your favorite happy creatures and other... things. An hour of playtime should grant you 4 cards, out of the total 8. In addition to the cards, you can get yourself a set of very happy emoji for your Steam chats and spooky backgrounds for your Steam profile, either by collecting cards and crafting badges, or via the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/]Points Shop[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/c6d044649e7844e56e71f789536e48e3ab4688f6.jpg[/img]

And if you haven't played Happy Game yet, well, maybe this is just one more reason to give it a try and experience Mr. Jaromír Plachý's most disturbing creation yet. 

Just remember: Happy Game is not a happy game.

Thank you so much for the support!

notes.title: Fix: High refresh rate monitors / high FPS
notes.content: This small update addresses an issue that occured on systems running high refresh rate monitors with very high frame rate (120+ fps), which made the game's point-and-drag mechanic a little bit harder (slower) to use. If you're a user of a high refresh rate monitor, the frame rate will now be capped at a lower value, closer to the standard 60 Hz, and the game will work as intended.

notes.title: Support ultrawide resolution.
notes.content: Game is now playable on screens with ultrawide resolution.

notes.title: Happy Game is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/ccc47750267479cde341aac8abd40aabb4f57d6c.png[/img]

The latest Amanita Design game has just landed on Steam! 

It’s Happy Game, our darkest, creepiest, and most twisted adventure so far, coming from the team behind Botanicula and CHUCHEL.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206060/Happy_Game/

Happy Game is an absurd horror adventure game designed by Jaromír Plachý, who previously brought you the family-friendly games Botanicula and CHUCHEL. This time, however, Jaromír decided to make something a little less cheerful, and the result of his team’s work is a psychedelic journey through a little boy’s three horrible nightmares, each with its own style, creatures and puzzles.

Get in the proper mood with the very happy launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=u7XQpAKqB7s;full][/previewyoutube]

Once again, we’re very happy to have worked with our favorite Czech music duo DVA, who created all of the spooky sounds and music for Happy Game. The original soundtrack is also available to purchase on Steam and is coming later to streaming services as well.

Please note: Happy Game is not a happy game.

notes.title: Amanita's unhappy Happy Game is coming in time for Halloween
notes.content:
Amanita Design are known for their cheery and charming adventure games, wonders like Samorost, Machinarium, Botanicula, and Chuchel. Their next game sounds like it should be their cheeriest yet, given that it's named Happy Game. Reader dear, this is a trick. Happy Game is blood and death and horror. You will see this soon, as Amanita today announced plans to release Happy Game on the 28th of October. Or you can try a demo now!

Read more

notes.title: TRAILER: Happy Game Is Releasing on Steam this October 28!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/ccc47750267479cde341aac8abd40aabb4f57d6c.png[/img]

The long-awaited news is finally here! Happy Game, the latest Amanita Design game designed by Jaromír Plachý (Botanicula, CHUCHEL) is releasing on Steam next Thursday, October 28th. Just in time for Halloween! To support the announcement of the new release date, we’ve made for you a rather unconventional trailer. Please watch it below and be sure to let us know how uncomfortable it made you feel.

[previewyoutube=u7XQpAKqB7s;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy Game will, as you're already used to, launch alongside DLC which includes the original soundtrack by Czech freak-folk duo DVA, as well as a hefty digital art book capturing Happy Game in various stages of development, from the initial designs to its final form. Great for those of you who need even more happiness in their life.

Thank you for your patience!

Stay happy ːchuchelsmileː

notes.title: EuroPlay 2021: Representing Czechia, it's Happy Game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/7dd2b38e5363de5d5427966a2d9763fdd22c63c0.png[/img]

This year's Gamescom is currently happening, and while we're not having an online booth or anything, our charming little Happy Game was chosen to represent our country, Czech Republic, in this year's EuroPlay competition. And maybe it will be your vote to decide who wins - you can now vote for your favorite happy game on [url=https://ukgotseuroplay.zohosites.com/europlay-vote-here]this website[/url], and it's literally a matter of 3 clicks (that includes opening the website.) Your support would make us very happy :)

If you'd like to watch the award ceremony stream, you can do so by registering to the event (optional, it means you'll get a reminder one hour prior to the show) via [url=https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/europlay-games-contest-at-gamescom-2021-tickets-162678308199]this link[/url], and then tuning in tomorrow (Thursday) at 7pm CET to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ukietv]UKIE.tv on Twitch[/url]. See you there.

Wish us luck!

notes.title: Horrific-looking Happy Game from Creaks developers coming this autumn
notes.content:
Cheekily-named Happy Game is the next puzzle-y adventure romp from the same folks that created point and click 'em ups Creaks and Chuchel. This one is about a little boy having an absolutely messed up nightmare. Here I thought my nightmares were bad. This kid absolutely has me beat. Happy Game is still looking terribly swell, but Amanita Design have announced alongside the trailer that it's being moved back to release in autumn of this year.

Read more

notes.title: Happy Game is releasing on Steam this fall
notes.content:
If you were watching the Future Games Show at E3, you already know the news - [b]Happy Game is launching on Windows, macOS, and Nintendo Switch this fall[/b]. Watch the new trailer featuring unseen footage and music by DVA below:

[previewyoutube=91KpBXSrk8k;full][/previewyoutube]

Unfortunately, we were unable to make it happen in spring as we initially announced, but in order to deliver the best possible Happy Game, we’re going to need these extra few months to add some more blood and fine-tune the screeches. Then again, Happy Game feels just like the right game to accompany you during the rainy days of grey autumn, and we hope you won’t mind the extra waiting too much.

With this off the table, you can now look forward to more Happy content here on Steam and our socials, as we’ll be getting closer to the new release window. We will specify the day and time of release as soon as we can.

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: An alarming number of heads explode in this trailer for Happy Game, coming this fall
notes.content: Christ. Amanita Design, everything OK? Watch the new trailer for Happy Game and you'll get why I'm worried... Read more.

notes.title: Vote for Happy Game in Indie Celebration!
notes.content:
Happy Game Demo is back on Steam for a limited time! You can download it from the game's store page now until 14th May, 6PM CET ːchuchelcrazyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206060/Happy_Game/

Happy Game is part of Indie Celebration, an event orchestrated by Digital Dragons. For two days, indie game fans are encouraged to visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/indie_celebration_2021]the event page[/url], download and play demos, and then choose their favorite one. If you end up enjoying Happy Game Demo, we'll be very happy if you give us a vote and add the game to your Steam wishlist! You can vote via [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/IndieCommunityVote]this link[/url].

On a side note - thank you for being so patient anticipating the full release, we'll have an announcement to make fairly soon...

notes.title: Happy Game Demo is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39356238/78331dd684d99de8636f1a254e2d0eec5f74973f.png[/img]

While we’re working our hardest to bring you the full experience as soon as we can, we wanted to share a little sneak peek with you in advance. [b]Happy Game Demo[/b] just landed on Steam and will be available on Windows and Mac for the next few days, up until February 9. You can download it now at the game's store page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206060/Happy_Game/

Please be aware that the experience can be quite intense. Be particularly cautious if you are sensitive to either flashing imagery, blood, or violence. There's rarely anything but that to see in Happy Game...

Please note: The demo is only playable using a mouse/touchpad.

We’re looking forward to hearing about your thoughts in the comments below or in the game’s forums!

Happy Steam Game Festival! ːchuchelsmileː

notes.title: Chuchel creators turning to horror in Happy Game
notes.content:
The makers of joyful adventure games like Chuchel last night announced Happy Game, and it most certainly is not so. They’re going grim ‘n’ gory with this “psychedelic horror adventure” next year, bursting with blood, bone, guts, grinders, guillotines, and even a skellington. But it still looks like an Amanita adventure game, even if you maybe shouldn’t share it with the kids. See for yourself in the trailer below.

(more…)
